purpose: Compute the single predeclared marine-access change metric after H1 is closed and before any H2 association is fitted.

encoding.raw_scale: divide by 10 to obtain percent concentration
encoding.note: Monthly Sea Ice Index applies the 15% cutoff; values below 15% are treated as open water in the predeclared metric.

roster.windows: Reuse each site's frozen early_window_start/end and late_window_start/end exactly.

metric.monthly_value: Projected Euclidean distance in km from the breeding-site coordinate to the nearest valid ocean grid-cell center with raw concentration <150.
metric.epoch_value: Median of all available monthly distances in the site's frozen epoch.
metric.favorable_change: M = early_distance_km - late_distance_km, so positive values mean open water became closer.

support_rule.site_pass: both early and late epochs pass

no_fishing_rule: No alternate ice threshold, month set, distance transform, or summary statistic may be selected after H2 is opened.
next_gate: Freeze and simulate the exact H2 land x marine two-way fixed-effect estimator on the final supported roster.
